title: I go to almost everywhere everyone talks about in these dreams EXCEPT the mall.
content: Almost every post I come across, everything EXCEPT the actual mall part is relevant. I have some really freaky ones where it’s many levels and layers in a house. Some parts are always more…dark and evil, if I’m being honest. And very cluttered, or newly redone with no furniture, just a sterile shitty blue carpet and white walls. Idk, the house mazes repeat a lot so that’s why I mention them. Sometimes the dreams repeat many times while I try to find my way out of these house mazes. And another thing, usually gravity gets weird in them. As I transition between levels, the gravity will shift from one side to the other, order completely flip so the ceiling becomes the floor or vice versa. But never have made it to the mall! I wonder why that is, anyone relate?
